For non-zero a, b, a × b is a unit vector and |a| = |b| = √2. The angle between them is —
questions.work: |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ = 2 sin θ = 1 ⇒ sin θ = ½ ⇒ θ = π/6.

questions.q: (i × j)·k + i·j equals —
questions.work: i × j = k, so k·k = 1; i·j = 0. Total 1.

sections.title: Objective type questions of four 1-mark parts.

questions.q: Answer: (i) What are xi, yj, zk called for r = xi + yj + zk? (ii) If |OA| = 4, |OB| = 5, |OC| = 6 along the axes, express OP. (iii) The centroid of ΔABC with position vectors a, b, c? (iv) The point dividing AB internally in 2 : 3?
questions.answer:
(i) The component vectors of r along the axes.
(ii) OP = 4i + 5j + 6k.
(iii) (a + b + c)/3.
(iv) (2b + 3a)/(2 + 3) = (3a + 2b)/5.

sections.title: Objective type question of six 1-mark parts.

questions.q: a = i + j + k and b = i − j + k. (a) Find a × b. (b) Find the angle between a and b. (c) Find the projection of a on b. (d) Is a × b = b × a? (e) Find the area of the parallelogram with a and b as diagonals. (f) Check whether |a × b|² = |a|²|b|² − (a·b)².
a = i + j + k and b = i + j. (a) a·b; (b) a unit vector ⊥ both; (c) area with a and b as diagonals; (d) verify |a × b|² = a²b² − (a·b)²; (e) |2b × a|; (f) is a × b = b × a?
questions.answer:
(a) 1 + 1 + 0 = 2.
(b) a × b = |i j k; 1 1 1; 1 1 0| = −i + j + 0k; unit vector (−i + j)/√2.
(c) ½|a × b| = ½√2 = √2/2.
(d) |a × b|² = 2; a²b² − (a·b)² = 3·2 − 4 = 2. Verified.
(e) |2b × a| = 2|a × b| = 2√2.
(f) No — they are opposite vectors.
